mapper.select: SELECT /*selectExportExIvExportCiProcDetail*/ '1' AS SELECTED, PODT.BUYER, POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE, PODT.RD_DATE, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE, PODT.MAKER_NAME , IVDT.INV_NO, PODT.ITEM_AMT, POHD.AGENT AS AGENT, POHD.PO_REMARK, PODT.DELAY_REMARK, PODT.SCM_REMARK, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE, NVL(IVDT.PKG_CI_QTY,0) GI_PKG_CI_QTY, IVDT.INV_QTY, IVDT.INV_SEQ, '1' AS LOT_IMG, IVDT.INV_QTY-NVL(IVDT.PKG_CI_QTY,0) AS PKG_CI_QTY, IVDT.INV_QTY-NVL(IVDT.PKG_CI_QTY,0) AS PKG_CI_QTY_2, POHD.AGENT, PRDT.EXP_CUR, PRDT.EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO, PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, PODT.PLANT, POHD.OVERSEA_TO_LOCATION, NVL(IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY,0) AS PKG_GR_QTY FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE PODT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND POHD.BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND PODT.BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND PODT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND PODT.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND PODT.PO_SEQ =#{st_po_seq} AND IVDT.INV_NO = #{st_inv_no} AND IVDT.INV_SEQ =#{st_inv_seq} AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' AND NVL(IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY,0) > 0 AND POHD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE =#{st_pkg_cmpy_no} AND NVL(IVDT.PKG_CI_QTY,0)< NVL(IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY,0) AND PRDT.EXP_CUR IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT '1' AS SELECTED, PODT.BUYER, POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE, PODT.RD_DATE, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE, PODT.MAKER_NAME , IVDT.INV_NO, PODT.ITEM_AMT, POHD.AGENT AS AGENT, POHD.PO_REMARK, PODT.DELAY_REMARK, PODT.SCM_REMARK, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE, NVL(IVDT.PKG_CI_QTY,0) GI_PKG_CI_QTY, IVDT.INV_QTY, IVDT.INV_SEQ, '1' AS LOT_IMG, IVDT.INV_QTY-NVL(IVDT.PKG_CI_QTY,0) AS PKG_CI_QTY, IVDT.INV_QTY-NVL(IVDT.PKG_CI_QTY,0) AS PKG_CI_QTY_2, POHD.AGENT, PRDT.EXP_CUR, PRDT.EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO, PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, PODT.PLANT, POHD.OVERSEA_TO_LOCATION, NVL(IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY,0) AS PKG_GR_QTY FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPRDT PRDT, WMSIVDT IVDT WHERE PODT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND POHD.BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND PODT.BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND PODT.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND PODT.PO_SEQ =#{st_po_seq} AND IVDT.INV_NO = #{st_inv_no} AND IVDT.INV_SEQ =#{st_inv_seq} AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE != '0' AND NVL(IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY,0) > 0 AND POHD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE =#{st_pkg_cmpy_no} AND NVL(IVDT.PKG_CI_QTY,0)< NVL(IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY,0) AND PRDT.EXP_CUR IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PO_NO, PO_SEQ
/* selectExportExIvExportCICheck */ SELECT COUNT(CI_NO) CNT FROM KEP_EXP_CIHD WHERE CI_NO = UPPER(#{st_ci_no})

SELECT /*"selectExportExIvExportCiItemList"*/ PODT.BUYER, PRDT.PURCHASER_DEPT AS PURCHASER_DEPT_CD, COD2.TEXT1 AS PURCHASE_DEPT, IVDT.INV_NO, PODT.DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION, IVDT.INV_QTY, IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY, NVL(IVDT.PKG_CI_QTY,0) GI_PKG_CI_QTY, IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY - NVL(IVDT.PKG_CI_QTY,0) AS PKG_CI_QTY, IVDT.INV_SEQ, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, PRDT.EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE, PRDT.EXP_CUR, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT, ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE PODT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE = '0' AND NVL(IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY,0) > 0 AND POHD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE =#{st_pkg_cmpy_no} AND NVL(IVDT.PKG_CI_QTY,0)< NVL(IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY,0) AND PRDT.EXP_CUR IS NOT NULL AND PRDT.BUYER = COD2.COMPANY_CODE(+) AND COD2.TYPE(+) = 'C001' AND PRDT.PURCHASER_DEPT = COD2.CODE(+) AND PODT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND IVDT.INV_NO LIKE #{st_inv_no2}||'%'
AND PODT.DESCRIPTION LIKE #{st_desc}||'%'
AND UPPER(COD2.TEXT1) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_purchase_dept}||'%')
UNION ALL SELECT PODT.BUYER, PRDT.PURCHASER_DEPT AS PURCHASER_DEPT_CD, COD2.TEXT1 AS PURCHASE_DEPT, IVDT.INV_NO, PODT.DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION, IVDT.INV_QTY, IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY, NVL(IVDT.PKG_CI_QTY,0) GI_PKG_CI_QTY, IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY - NVL(IVDT.PKG_CI_QTY,0) AS PKG_CI_QTY, IVDT.INV_SEQ, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, PRDT.EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE, PRDT.EXP_CUR, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPRDT PRDT, WMSIVDT IVDT, ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE PODT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE != '0' AND NVL(IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY,0) > 0 AND POHD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE =#{st_pkg_cmpy_no} AND NVL(IVDT.PKG_CI_QTY,0)< NVL(IVDT.PKG_GR_QTY,0) AND PRDT.EXP_CUR IS NOT NULL AND PRDT.BUYER = COD2.COMPANY_CODE(+) AND COD2.TYPE(+) = 'C001' AND PRDT.PURCHASER_DEPT = COD2.CODE(+) AND PODT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND IVDT.INV_NO LIKE #{st_inv_no2}||'%'
AND UPPER(COD2.TEXT1) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_purchase_dept}||'%')
AND PODT.DESCRIPTION LIKE #{st_desc}||'%'
ORDER BY PURCHASE_DEPT, INV_NO
